summary: Compare pilot-only screens (mRMR, RF-importance re-screen) by 5-fold CV on pilot
reasoning: step-20/21 leaderboard shows RF knobs gain ~+0.005 only. The lever left within the route is the screen itself: mRMR or RF-importance re-screening may pack more independent directions into ≤50 features. This diagnostic compares candidate pilot-only screens by 5-fold CV (screen inside folds) and inspects correlation structure; it writes no metrics. If one screen beats F-top-25's 0.7316 by ≥~0.015 on pilot, it becomes the procedure of the next full run.
